2023_001_oct_2023_pcard_report_002.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction register for October 2023 was presented to the Board of Education for its meeting of December 12, 2023. The 45-page listing, footed 12/11/2023, records every card charge posted under the journal-entry description "OCT 2023 PCARD EXP" for the billing cycle running 9/26/2023 through 10/25/2023, showing each transaction's merchant abbreviation, budget unit, account code, amount and any credit. The register closes with a Subtotal of 405,182.71 in charges against 4,007.03 in credits, and Total Expenses of 401,175.68.
